mapper.select: select p.id as post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.created_at as post_created_at, u.email, u.nickname, u.created_at as user_created_at from users u inner join posts p on u.id = p.user_id where p.id = #{id}

select p.id as post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.created_at as post_created_at, u.email, u.nickname, u.created_at as user_created_at from users u inner join posts p on u.id = p.user_id order by post_id desc limit #{offset} , #{size}
